flags.assumption: Calling scanner.next().split(" ") on line 7 assumes scanner.next() reads the entire line containing both S and T separated by a single space, whereas scanner.next() stops at the first whitespace character.
flags.suggestion: Replace line 7 with: scanner.nextLine(); String[] input = scanner.nextLine().trim().split("\\s+");
flags.reasoning: For any standard two-token input such as "abc def" on the second line, scanner.next() returns only "abc". Splitting "abc" on " " produces a one-element array, so line 9 (input[1]) throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. Furthermore, split(" ") does not collapse runs of whitespace or strip leading/trailing whitespace like Python split() with no arguments.
